Hold the left pad to walk and the right pad to look around. Plan switches between the options, Room jumps to the next room.
W A S Dwalk
Arrow keys, or mouselook around
Shiftrun
Spacejump
Gjump to the next room
Lroom lights on or off
[ and ]move the sun an hour
Escexit and get your mouse back
